admission.justification: Releasing input against the earlier agent or blanking the sole frame would violate selection ownership without helping native drawing.

applicability: Input and waiting presentation while a document selection changes.
conditions: The pane shows the application native screen rather than retaining a second picture.
Negotiated on-chat is exact selected-screen evidence; drawing is a separate completion.
exclusions: An older plugin can settle its waiting line at its earlier answer as the notice explains.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "is let through when the application says it is on the chat, while the line stays until the chat is shown"; dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoPluginBridge.test.ts › "tells a dashboard that reads it once when the application is on the agent's chat, before the chat is drawn"; dashboard/src/cockpit/document-chat/knownChats.test.tsx › "keeps the earlier chat shown and out of reach while it asks, and hides the frame only on the answer no chat"; sent-text probes S-tip and S-old of Attempt3

statement: On a change of the selection the frame is never hidden or blanked; it takes no input from the click until the application is on the selection's chat, and the dashboard's one line stays until the conversation is shown.
